# Domain action

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

One principal-first Action owns the write. It checks lock_version against stale writes, which also stops concurrent edits, and is shared by controllers, jobs and MCP tools.

Scaffold: `php artisan standards:make action --flavor=plain <Name>`.

Kit: none.
Checks: actions, 21. Run `php artisan standards:check --changed` before committing.
